{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute and print the number of missing values in body_mass_g
num_missing = df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Number of missing values in body_mass_g: {num_missing}")

# Compute and print the number of rows in the cleaned dataset
num_rows_clean = len(df_clean)
print(f"Number of rows after dropping missing body_mass_g: {num_rows_clean}")

# Compute and print the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = df_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()
print(f"Mean body mass in grams: {mean_body_mass}")"}
